subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should Mattermost history reads be enabled by default for configurations that omit `actions.messages`, and should the core action-level gate remain the approved authorization owner for that new delegated-read exception?
rationale: Both choices alter existing-user capability exposure and the core/plugin authorization boundary; the tests can prove either implementation but cannot select the product and trust policy.

options.title: Make upgrades opt in
options.body: Keep fresh-install discovery explicit, but treat an absent existing-config setting as disabled until an operator enables Mattermost history reads.

options.title: Approve default-on discovery
options.body: Accept that upgraded Mattermost configurations gain the read action, with the documented allowlist and provider checks as the intended safeguards.

options.title: Revisit authorization ownership
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define whether this narrow core allowlist or a different bundled-plugin capability contract is the permanent trust model.

recommendation.title: Make upgrades opt in
recommendation.body: Keep fresh-install discovery explicit, but treat an absent existing-config setting as disabled until an operator enables Mattermost history reads.
